objective: Estimate prior context reductions and trace Skill/reference/help reads to BGS responsibilities before changing the system.

priorSavingsEstimate.exactMeasure: UTF-8 bytes removed from saved tool receipts by current default serialization/projection, keeping the original call sequence fixed.
priorSavingsEstimate.weightMethod: For each output, count subsequent token_usage_record events before the next compacted record. This assumes the original compaction schedule and context retention remain unchanged.
priorSavingsEstimate.tokenHeuristic: No offline DeepSeek tokenizer is available. Dividing bytes by 3 to 5 gives a sensitivity estimate, not a statistical confidence interval or measured token saving; indentation whitespace may tokenize very differently.
priorSavingsEstimate.billingBoundary: Includes cached input. These values are neither uncached-token savings nor monetary savings. A different compaction schedule can change retention, later reads and total input.
excluded: The x-reasoning-included correction removed 104590 erroneous estimated context tokens at the observed boundary; that is accounting/compaction correctness, not provider billing savings.
Avoided model rounds from user-playtest scope changes have not been measured.
Transcript search exclusion and compact resource registration may avoid future reads, but their benefits remain conditional and are not added to these totals.
The imagegen availability fix below is not included in prior savings.

findings.observed: Native call 37/output 54 read the complete system imagegen Skill: 14139 body characters, 14179 UTF-8 body bytes. The project subsequently used the existing BGS resource command. The Skill describes native image_gen and an OPENAI_API_KEY-dependent CLI fallback.
findings.cause: BGS custom-provider sessions set requires_openai_auth=false without actor authorization. The current native image-generation gate therefore returns false. The BGS bridge only forwards Responses routes, and the shell environment excludes API keys. Native system-skill installation/discovery nevertheless advertises this Skill.
findings.fix: For non-ChatGPT game sessions, set one existing skills.config path rule to enabled=false for BGS_HOME/skills/.system/imagegen/SKILL.md in the native process CLI configuration. Both the runner's skills/list cache and native thread discovery inherit it. Do not delete files, change user configuration, disable by name or add instructions.
findings.compatibility: Preserve imported skills with the same name, other user enablement rules, built-in game skills and ChatGPT sessions. Model-list-only processes need no Skill override. Future changes to BGS provider image capabilities must revisit this condition.

conditionalContextImpact.classification: Potential avoided read and carriage, not measured savings or a bound. The model may still explicitly read an old path from retained history; disabling catalog availability does not erase prior conversations or deny filesystem reads.

findings.observed: The initial phase explicitly read 13 Skill bodies and 3 references. Later commands reread planning/evidence/playtest bodies after compaction and during final checks. No automatic per-turn Skill body injection was established.
findings.decision: Do not add another selector prompt, force deduplication or prohibit legitimate rereads. The earlier c6e7a3484 scope changes already alter planning/playtest responsibilities, so historical bodies are not current defects. A later choice of static sprites alone cannot prove that an earlier animation-reference exploration was unnecessary. Conditional systems/creative advice and cross-role overlap do not establish a proportionate runtime fix.

findings.observed: assets generate --help and ui-board-plan --help each returned the same 4118-character help text; consumer --api returned approximately 9.4K characters. The caller explicitly requested each output. The help branch returns before capability/network access.
findings.decision: Do not add selective API discovery or more mandatory reads. Full consumer API output matches its existing signatures/shapes/lifecycle contract. The duplicate help is a small explicit-read cost; maintaining separate command docs or a read cache is not justified by this trace.

planAndSelfReview: Trace catalog installation, native capability gates, bridge routes, shell credentials and actual reads before attributing the problem to Skill selection.
Use the existing native config layer at the game-runner boundary; keep native binaries, Skill bodies, asset commands and public result contracts unchanged.
Apply the rule at process startup, not only thread/start, so the runner's cached catalog and native thread view agree.
Match only the unsupported system path. Native configuration merges User and SessionFlags rules; unrelated user disables must survive.
Verify a fresh home before the system Skill exists and reopen the same home as ChatGPT to check that the change is temporary.
Do not depend on the model obeying another warning: availability filtering is deterministic. Do not claim it prevents direct file reads or removes old history.
Reject text splitting, new help modes, deduplication state and extra model calls without a demonstrated benefit that offsets maintenance and context costs.

validation.limitations: No paid rerun, project modification, service restart or post-fix end-to-end cost measurement. This fixes a catalog/capability mismatch; it does not establish that other Skill reads are unnecessary or that overall task tokens will fall by a guaranteed percentage.
